description: Check whether a person is already in the customer's connected CRM, by name or e-mail and optionally their profile link. Uses no lookup credit. A record that matches on name alone is reported as a possible match, never as proof; the customer's answer is recorded with confirm_possible_match.

company.description: the person's company; helps to tell two people with the same name apart

email.description: an e-mail address the person is known by

name.description: the person's full name; required unless an e-mail is given

profile_url.description: link to the person's public profile page; the strongest way to tell people apart, but give the full name or an e-mail as well

name: find_person_in_crm

match.description: the person's record, when they are in the CRM for certain

company_match.description: for a possible match: whether the record's company agrees with the one given

email_conflict.description: true when the record holds an e-mail address that none of the person's known addresses matches, which argues against it being the same person

entity_type.description: contact or lead, in CRMs that have both

match.description: profile_link, email or confirmed for a certain match; name for a possible one

profile_url.description: the public profile link the record holds, when it holds one

record_id.description: the record's id in the CRM; pass it to get_crm_record, update_crm_record or log_crm_activity

url.description: link to the record in the CRM; share it with the customer

possible_matches.description: records with the same name that may or may not be the same person; never treat these as the person being in the CRM
